note: Simulated. Only trip 1 is real (the overnight Muse run). Trips 2-10 show how the same rules would play out over a year of trips.

trips.name: Spring break, Mexico City
trips.event: Muse booked a hotel for the wrong month. Lodging went back to asking first, and the limit reset to $750.

categories.name: Flights
categories.trip1: Reserve alone if refundable, cancel window past wake-up, within limit
categories.trip10: Books alone up to $450 if refundable

categories.name: Beds
categories.trip10: Asks first when it's dorm vs. private
categories.evidence: You changed 5 of 11; lost autonomy after the wrong-month booking

categories.name: Seats
categories.trip10: Picks alone, pays up to $25 for a window

categories.name: Non-refundable anything
categories.evidence: Fixed. Irreversible spend never becomes automatic.

learned.rule: Budgets are CAD and cover transport + beds, not food
Layovers over 4h are a dealbreaker if the fix costs under $200
Private room when it's under $25/night more than a dorm
Before 7 AM is fine only if it saves $100+
Double-check dates against the calendar before any hold
